pictures.author: Bahnfrend
pictures.observed: Southwest exterior: broad pale board-formed concrete rectangular upper fascia over large irregular rounded grey/brown fieldstones, dark recessed bronze entrance near the left end of the front face, narrow separation below the overhanging roof and small floodlights on its rim. Structured data identifies Ohel Yizkor asQ6826871.

pictures.author: Andrew Shiva / Wikipedia (Godot13)
pictures.observed: Previously viewed aerial: separate square Hall of Remembrance has a tall thick concrete rim and depressed inner roof; dark rough base. Independent museum prism, road and nearby buildings are context.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Hall of Remembrance (Ohel Yizkor), Yad Vashem: exact mapped square roof on a recessed rough fieldstone base, large blank concrete fascia, continuous shadow gap, depressed inner roof and thick parapet, recessed west-end front bronze entrance and small roof floodlights. Individual faceted boulders appear nearby; all LODs keep the stone/concrete contrast and off-centre entry. Interior memorial floor, flame, names/inscriptions and site sculptures are excluded. All other Yad Vashem buildings and memorials remain separate.
